<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Witness 2026-09-02 (weasel): a hand-started Copilot CLI in tmux, adopted into pij-rs (pij-accused-keech, %3136), received NOTHING from `pij-rs send` — receipt said `queued`, no pointer, no body, no daemon log line for the pane. Cause: the HELD legacy TS daemon pipe-panes every pane on the machine into ~/.pij/pane-signals/_N.raw and sets no @pij-tap-sink marker; crates/tmux/src/lib.rs ~L868 sees pane_pipe=1 with no matching marker and refuses (`already has an output pipe not owned by this sink`), so InteractionGate::refresh_live_tap returns false, fresh_injection_verdict returns permitted=false/composer_idle=false, submit_with_owned_input returns Deferred, and the row sits queued forever with no reason. Proof: `tmux pipe-pane -t %3136` (close legacy pipe) → rs observer claimed the tap within 20s → second send returned delivered/typed-to-pane and Copilot answered `seen`. Same refusal is spamming ~25k daemon.log lines for %3112 (CPU + disk). The legacy daemon stays running until seat migration (req-0039) lands, so rs must coexist: supersede legacy-generation taps, still refuse genuinely foreign pipes, log once per pane, and make the queued receipt say WHY and retry once the tap is owned. This is the s122 full-body delivery (PR #355, merged dd450381) being blocked at the tap, not at the typing.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Hand-started Copilot/Codex panes get full-body typed delivery even when the legacy daemon tapped the pane first.
- rs pane observer adopts a legacy-generation tap (pane_pipe=1, no @pij-tap-sink marker, legacy sink ~/.pij/pane-signals/_N.raw present) instead of refusing; genuinely unknown pipes are still refused.
- A pane delivery deferred for want of a tap sink returns queued WITH a reason (tap-unowned), is logged once per pane not per tick, and the drain retries it after the tap is claimed (req-0042 partial).
- A message queued by the human-typing/composer veto is retried by the daemon when the veto lifts, and the receipt names the veto (req-0042 socket half). Note for the register: adopt records pane_pid (the shell) as proc for hand-started-in-a-shell harnesses; UDS pane fallback covers it, so no bind change in this plan.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Killing or modifying the legacy TS daemon (held by ruling 2026-09-02-legacy-shutdown-held-for-129.md).
- Composer-busy / human-typing deferral policy (req-0042 remainder) beyond naming the reason.
- Any write to the operator homes (~/.claude, ~/.claude-alt, ~/.pij, ~/.pij-rs) before merge; live proof runs a dev daemon on its own state dir/port with the production legacy daemon left RUNNING.

Receipt reads {outcome:queued, reason:"human-typing", next_retry_at:&lt;timestamp&gt;} (additive). Measured destination fact for witness message 55C220EB: jobs row 926 entered the delivery queue at 1788323412, was claimed/acked at 1788323581, and reached attempt 34 — 169 seconds in queue, not 12 hours. Separate provenance note: the sender claimed ~02:50Z while destination enqueued_at was ~14:30 local, so the 12-hour gap preceded admission (sender side, or a send that never reached this daemon) and is out of scope for this plan. No row already admitted to a live recipient with a blank composer may outlive one delivery_interval_secs cadence. | — | — | — |
